# Smeasy

> Simple staff rostering for Australian small businesses — cafés, restaurants, bars, shops and other small teams. Free during early access.

## What Smeasy does
- Managers sign in with an emailed login link (no password).
- Build a weekly roster: tap a day to add a shift with start, finish, unpaid break and role. Split shifts and shifts past midnight are supported.
- Copy last week's roster in one tap.
- See paid hours per person and for the team, plus a wage estimate from base hourly rates (no penalty rates or super).
- Publish when ready; drafts stay private.
- Share with staff via one team roster link (for the staff group chat) or a printable A4 PDF. Staff need no app, account or password, and see only names, days, times and roles.
- Staff request time off from a personal link; managers approve or decline on the roster.
- Download paid hours as a CSV with payroll IDs for Xero, MYOB or a bookkeeper.
- Data is stored in Australia (Sydney).

## What Smeasy does not do (yet)
- No automatic notifications (SMS, email or push).
- No in-app shift swaps.
- No award interpretation, penalty-rate calculation or payroll processing.
- No ready-to-import Xero/MYOB timesheet files (CSV only for now).
- One manager login and one location per business.
